title: Order processing time
answer: Orders are processed within 1 to 2 business days after payment. Business days are Monday to Friday, excluding public holidays.

title: Standard shipping time
answer: Standard shipping within the United States takes 3 to 7 business days after your order ships.

title: Express shipping time
answer: Express shipping within the United States takes 1 to 3 business days after your order ships.

title: Where we ship
answer: We ship to the United States and Canada. We do not ship to any other country.

title: Shipping time to Canada
answer: Shipping to Canada takes 7 to 14 business days after your order ships.

title: Standard shipping cost
answer: Standard shipping within the United States costs a flat $5.99.

title: Free shipping threshold
answer: Standard shipping within the United States is free on orders of $50 or more before tax.

title: Express shipping cost
answer: Express shipping within the United States costs a flat $14.99.

title: Shipping cost to Canada
answer: Shipping to Canada costs a flat $12.99. Duties and taxes at the border are not included.

title: When a tracking number appears
answer: A tracking number appears once the carrier has picked up and scanned your parcel, usually 1 to 2 business days after your order ships.

title: Checking your order status
answer: If you send me your order number and the email address used for the order, I can look up its status and tracking number.

title: Tracking shows no movement
answer: After the first scan, tracking can take up to 48 hours to show new movement.

title: Holiday delays
answer: During public holidays and the last two weeks of December, processing and delivery can take 1 to 3 business days longer than usual.

title: Processing on public holidays
answer: Orders are not processed or shipped on public holidays.

title: Order is later than expected
answer: If your order has not arrived 10 business days after it shipped, it is treated as lost. I can pass your request to our team.

title: Return window
answer: You can return an item within 30 days of the delivery date.

title: Return conditions
answer: Returned items must be unused, in their original packaging, and with all tags attached.

title: Items that cannot be returned
answer: Gift cards, final-sale items and personalised items cannot be returned.

title: Who pays return shipping
answer: You pay the return shipping cost, unless the item arrived damaged or was not what you ordered.

title: How to start a return
answer: To start a return, ask for a member of our team and I will pass your request on.

title: Refund timing
answer: Refunds go back to the original payment method within 5 to 7 business days after we receive and inspect the returned item.

title: Is shipping refunded
answer: The original shipping fee is refunded only if the return is because of our mistake, such as a damaged or wrong item.

title: Exchanges
answer: You can exchange an item for a different size or colour within 30 days of delivery, if the new one is in stock.

title: Item arrived damaged
answer: If your item arrived damaged, report it within 7 days of delivery. Our team may ask for a photo, and you can choose a replacement or a refund.

title: Wrong item received
answer: If you received the wrong item, report it within 7 days of delivery. You do not pay return shipping.

title: Parcel lost
answer: If your parcel has not arrived 10 business days after it shipped, tell us and you can choose a replacement or a refund.

title: Changing the delivery address
answer: You can change the delivery address only before your order ships. Once it has shipped, the address cannot be changed.

title: Cancelling an order
answer: You can cancel an order only before it ships. Once it has shipped, you can return it after it arrives.

title: Refund after cancellation
answer: A cancelled order is refunded to the original payment method within 5 to 7 business days.

title: Payment methods
answer: At checkout we accept major credit cards, PayPal and Apple Pay. This is a demo store, so no real payment is taken.

title: When you are charged
answer: Your payment method is charged when you place the order.

title: Payment failed
answer: If a payment fails, the order is not placed and you are not charged for it.

title: Reaching a person
answer: You can ask for a member of our team right here, and I will pass your request on.

title: Team hours
answer: Our team is available Monday to Friday, 9 am to 5 pm Eastern Time.

title: How fast the team replies
answer: A member of our team replies within 1 business day.

title: This is a demo store
answer: Gisting Lab Store is a demo with fictional orders. Please do not share real personal or payment details here.

title: Why we ask for your email
answer: I can share order details only after you give the order number and the email address used for the order.

title: How your messages are used
answer: Your messages are used only to answer your question in this demo.
